title: Physical properties of elementary particles: Inertia and Interaction
summary: Matter has two physical properties: Inertia and interaction. If we define the center of mass of an elementary particle in relation to its inertia, and a center of interaction in relation to its interactive properties, there are only two possibilities to describe this elementary particle: that both points are the same or that they are different. If they are the same, what we describe is the point particle model, while if we consider them to be different, what we obtain is the description of an elementary spinning particle.
